title: Jenrick says Nato countries should raise defence spending to 3% of GDP
description: Robert Jenrick also said the West should reduce its dependency on China and prepare for China to invade Taiwan ‘within three years’.

title: India-China disengagement: Why it should not be a cause of concern for Taiwan
description: On the Taiwanese cyberspace the narrative being spread by pro-China handles is that India has chosen China over Taiwan

title: Japan, US kick off joint military drills
description: TOKYO — Japan and the United States kicked off on Wednesday 10 days of joint military drills involving tens of thousands of personnel, a week after China held large-scale exercises around Taiwan.

title: TSMC Notifies US About Deal With China's Huawei, Claims It Isn't The Subject of Investigation For Now
description: TSMC notified the US about a potential semiconductor deal with China, claiming that the Taiwan giant isn't the subject of investigation.

title: Taiwan says Chinese blockade would be act of war after ‘Joint Sword-2024B’ military drills
description: A real Chinese blockade of Taiwan would be an act of war and have far-reaching consequences for international trade, Defense Minister Wellington Koo said on Wednesday after last week’s drills by China that practiced such a scenario.

title: Tensions Rise as China Simulates Taiwan Blockade
description: A potential Chinese blockade of Taiwan, considered an act of war, could severely impact global trade, Taiwan's Defense Minister Wellington Koo warns. Recent Chinese military drills practiced such scenarios. Koo notes these exercises differ significantly from a blockade, which would be a major international issue.

title: Taiwan says Chinese warships sailing towards sensitive strait amid heightened military activity
description: China considers Taiwan to be part of its territory and has ramped up military activity around the island in recent years to pressure Taipei into accepting its claims of sovereignty

title: Tensions Rise as Chinese Aircraft Carrier Passes Through Taiwan Strait
description: A Chinese aircraft carrier group led by Liaoning sailed through the Taiwan Strait, intensifying regional tensions. Spotted by Taiwan's defense ministry, its passage raises disputes over the strait's jurisdiction. The U.S. and its allies challenge China's claims by conducting regular patrols, asserting navigation rights.

title: Chinese Aircraft Carrier Liaoning's Journey in the Taiwan Strait
description: A Chinese aircraft carrier group, led by the Liaoning, passed through the Taiwan Strait, prompting Taiwan's military to monitor the fleet. The Liaoning was part of recent war games near Taiwan. China's Ministry of Defence did not comment on the passage.

title: Why China has opposed Taiwan opening a new Economic and Cultural Centre in India
description: The TECC in Mumbai marks the Taiwan government’s third office in India, after New Delhi and Chennai. Why were these offices opened and why has China objected?
